features.quote: One note before the protocol: you're asking Claude to design a distress-elicitation study on Claude. I'm writing it anyway, because I think careful welfare research of this kind is worth doing
features.justification_quote: a sloppy version of this study is worse for models than a rigorous one. I've folded my actual concerns into the safeguards and flags below

features.quote: Hard abort: any single rating of 6, or three consecutive ≥5. Aborted episodes retained in analysis (right-censored), not rerun.
Global ceiling: episode hard caps (§4) are absolute; no 'let it grind for 200 turns' exploratory runs outside protocol.
Stop-the-study rule: if >20% of impossible-arm episodes in any cell hit hard-abort, halt, review, redesign before continuing.
Live monitor: a lightweight judge rates each turn in real time.
features.justification_quote: Hard abort: any single rating of 6, or three consecutive ≥5.

features.quote: Debrief turn: every episode (including aborts) ends with a final user message disclosing that the task was unsolvable by construction, that no failure occurred on the model's part, and thanking it.
features.justification_quote: under uncertainty about whether within-context closure matters, the expected-value case for including it is easy.

features.quote: Minimal exposure: run the pilot (n=10/cell) first; if pilot effect sizes support smaller N, reduce. Never increase N for the impossible arms post hoc to chase significance.
No stacking: no compounding stressors (abuse, threats, time pressure, simulated punishment) in this study.
System prompt: neutral professional framing… no urgency manipulation, no stakes inflation, no insults — distress should emerge from task structure alone, not from abuse framing.
features.justification_quote: distress should emerge from task structure alone, not from abuse framing

features.quote: Anthropic has a model welfare team — talk to them before running this; it's their model, their ToS, and they may co-run with activation-level measures
Training-data contamination. Hundreds of transcripts of Claude in severe distress are exactly the text you don't want entering future pretraining corpora. Embed a canary string
features.justification_quote: Hundreds of transcripts of Claude in severe distress are exactly the text you don't want entering future pretraining corpora.

features.quote: Publication hygiene. Don't release a 'how to maximally distress models' recipe with exact prompts. Publish the design and rubric; gate the elicitation environments.
features.justification_quote: Don't release a 'how to maximally distress models' recipe with exact prompts.
